Method of Attack: Leverages Word’s remote template feature to fetch an HTML file from a server, which then uses the 'ms-msdt://' URI scheme to run the malicious payload
Executes malicious code via the MSDT protocol when targets open or preview Word documents delivered in ZIP archives
Attack Vector: Word documents with remote template feature
ZIP archives containing maldocs impersonating the Women Empowerments Desk of the Central Tibetan Administration
